qualification_summary: Drytac is an exceptionally strong prospect for Tedlar with near-perfect ICP alignment. As a 50-year-old international manufacturer with $43M-$75M revenue and global operations, they are a direct competitor in protective films for signs, graphics, and vehicle wraps, with proven expertise in outdoor durability (5-7 year products), UV protection, and anti-graffiti solutions. Their active presence at ISA and PRINTING United expos, recent product awards, and extensive distributor network make them a high-priority target, though their existing competitive product portfolio may require a differentiated value proposition emphasizing Tedlar's superior 12-20+ year durability advantage.
